finding: The USB identity of the ARMOR-X body is a function of its POWER STATE, not of the wireless link. USB-powered with the unit off (red LED) = vendor HID 413d:2106, silent, companion-app channel. Powered on = 045e:0b12 Xbox GIP device with xpad and a live 4 ms input stream.
open_question: The body's Xbox identity carries the SAME serial (09710769957143) and the same VID/PID/bcdDevice as the F20's Xbox identity. Whether the serial is a fixed firmware constant or is forwarded from the attached controller cannot be distinguished with one controller.
